name: The Way We Dress
overview: Scripture teaches that the way we dress is a reflection of our reverence for God and our commitment to His standards. God commands clear distinctions in dress between men and women, warning that crossing these boundaries is an abomination to Him. Additionally, attire that promotes pride, haughtiness, or sensuality is condemned, as seen in the warnings against ostentatious display and the allure of seductive clothing. True beauty and favor come not from outward appearance but from a heart that fears the Lord, emphasizing godly character over external adornment.
